items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 98:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the river that spreads in its sides? YESHSUT, who clothe upon the NHY of Aba and Ima, are discerned as the aspect of a river that comes out of Eden, as in the adjacent answer. And they are also discerned as the aspect of a river that spreads in its sides, for there is the aspect of the coupling of the Yesodot of Aba and Ima. For the Yod, which is the aspect of Hochma and Israel Saba, spreads toward the side of above in the aspect of the Yesod of Ima, and spreads toward the side of below in the aspect of the Yesod of Aba, through which the illumination of Hochma is bestowed to the Vav that is within the He, which is the ZA in the pregnancy, standing there in these NHY of Aba and Ima. For they clothe the two shoulders of AA, where the NHY of Aba and Ima are included with ZA. As is known. And see above, Answer 65. (Item 61).
